title: Ear-EEG Sleep Monitoring 2023 (EESM23)
description: The Ear-EEG Sleep Monitoring 2023 (EESM23) dataset contains overnight ear-EEG recordings from 10 healthy participants, collected at home between 2020 and 2022. The first two recordings per subject also include polysomnography (PSG), while the remaining recordings are ear-EEG only. Each recording consists of a pre-sleep video sequence followed by a sleep sequence, separated by subject-triggered markers.
methods_description: Participants wore ear-EEG equipment during nightly recordings at home. For the first two recordings the equipment was mounted in the afternoon alongside PSG; for later recordings participants mounted the ear-EEG themselves just before bed. Participants kept diaries and used a trigger button to mark recording start, electrode test, bedtime, lights-out and recording end. Data are stored in EEGLAB .set format within a BIDS structure.
